def E(k):
 i,j,k=k

  px=s.Poly(F,X); DX=s.factor(s.discriminant(px.as_expr(),X))
  odd=[f for f,e in s.factor_list(DX)[1] if e%2 and s.degree(f,Y)>0]

  P=s.Poly(F,Y); A,B,C=[P.nth(j) for j in (2,1,0)]
  Norm=s.factor((A-C)**2+B**2)
  fl=s.factor_list(Norm)[1]

  Im=s.expand((L-s.conjugate(L).subs({s.conjugate(t):t,s.conjugate(X):X}))/(2*I))
